content: संश्रयः .²1 A resting or dwelling place, residence, habitation; त्वं सदा संश्रयः शैल स्वर्गमार्गाभिकाङ्क्षिणाम् <ls>Mb. 3. 42. 22</ls>; परस्परविरोधिन्योरेकसंश्रयदुर्लभम् <ls>V. 5. 24</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 41</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> in this sense and translated by ‘residing with’, ‘relating or pertaining to’, ‘with reference to’; ज्ञातिकुलैकसंश्रयाम् <ls>Ś. 5. 17</ls>; नौसंश्रयः <ls>R. 16. 57</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 17</ls>; मनोरथोऽस्याः शशिमौलिसंश्रयः <ls>Ku. 5. 60</ls>; द्विसंश्रयां प्रीतिमवाप लक्ष्मीः <ls n="Ku.">1. 43</ls>; एकार्थसंश्रयमुभयोः प्रयोगम् <ls>M. 1</ls>. .²2 Seeking protection or shelter with, fleeing for refuge, forming or seeking alliance, leaguing together for mutual protection; one of the 6 guṇas or expedients in politics; see under गुण also; संश्रयवृत्तिः <ls>Kau. A. 7</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 160</ls>. .²3 Resort, refuge, asylum, protection, shelter; अनपायिनि संश्रयद्रुमे गजभग्ने पतनाय वल्लरी <ls>Ku. 4. 31</ls>; <ls>Me. 17</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 22</ls>. .²4 Attachment (for home, relatives <ab>&c.</ab>); तथा प्रयत्नं कुर्वीत यथा मुच्येत संश्रयात् <ls>Mb. 12. 293. 20</ls>. .²5 A piece or portion belonging to anything.
